title: Buildings used to park, repair or service tank vehicles: occupancy classification and restrictions
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide STANDATA issued by Alberta Municipal Affairs)
code_edition: NBC(AE) 2023 and NFC(AE) 2023 (National Fire Code - 2023 Alberta Edition); printing not stated in document
document_date: Date Issued: July 2025 (platform created July 21, 2025, last updated July 21, 2025)

facts.text: The interpretation clarifies NBC(AE) and NFC(AE) application to buildings used for parking, repairing or servicing tank vehicles.
Buildings used for parking tank vehicles containing flammable or combustible gases or vapours are classified as Group F, Division 1 high-hazard industrial occupancies.
No person shall repair, service or store a tank vehicle in a building other than for repairs conducted in conformance with Article 4 as cited in the document.
In a building with more than one major occupancy, the requirements for the most restricted major occupancy apply to the whole building.
